message:
Yen receipts now show correctly, e.g. `Paid ¥500 by card`. The yen test passes, and the full `npm test` run passes all 18 tests.

The real bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file belongs to other teams and is outside this task's scope, so I didn't touch it. Instead I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js`, which now formats yen amounts directly as whole units and leaves other currencies to `formatMoney`.

Invoices, the cart and admin still call `formatMoney` and will show yen wrong. Their owners may want to fix it in the shared helper. If they do, the special case in `receipt.js` can be removed.
